name: Nepalese
summary: **Nepalese** is a [[kind:landrace|landrace]] [[label:sativa|sativa]] from the hill regions of [[country:NP|Nepal]], traditionally grown for hashish production. Plants can exceed 3 metres and take 18 to 20 weeks to finish, harvested outdoors in October or November. It is not well suited to indoor cultivation.
